==================
Line comment with hash
==================

# this is a comment
see "Hello"

---

(source_file
  (comment)
  (see_statement
    (string)))

==================
Line comment with double slash
==================

// this is a comment
see "Hello"

---

(source_file
  (comment)
  (see_statement
    (string)))

==================
Block comment
==================

/* this is
   a block comment */
see "Hello"

---

(source_file
  (comment)
  (see_statement
    (string)))

==================
Inline comment after statement
==================

see "Hello" # inline comment

---

(source_file
  (see_statement
    (string))
  (comment))
